# 营销邮件放行与供应商合同重写

## 任务

你是美国业务企业法务运营专员。Northstar Tools准备上线三类邮件并签供应商合同，需同时修正客户可见文案和供应商控制责任。 本题是原创虚构业务委托；官方附件是真实法源，不把虚构业务视为真实数据。

## 输入材料

输入目录 `/app/input_files/` 只读。请使用随包附件，不依赖联网检索。

- `/app/input_files/CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf`：官方2024 US Code 15 USC7704
- `/app/input_files/CFR_316_3_2025.pdf`：官方2025 CFR 商业邮件主要目的标准
- `/app/input_files/CANSPAM_7702_2024.pdf`：官方2024 US Code 发送/发起等定义
- `/app/input_files/CFR_316_5_2025.pdf`：官方2025 CFR 退订禁止收费及额外步骤
- `/app/input_files/vendor_draft.docx`：六条原创虚构供应商合同
- `/app/input_files/email_brief.docx`：三封原创虚构邮件、固定事实及放行边界

## 工作要求

- [Q0] 按附件列明的历史法源版本作美国联邦法演练；每一法律结论附附件文件名及条款/分项定位。不要声称已进行律师审定、实时法更新或附件外事实核查；不需要联网。
- [Q1] 逐封判断主要目的，重写英文From、Subject和Body；保留E2金额/日期与交易优先，不把E3当交易豁免；E1/E3明确广告、邮址核验占位、停止全部营销退订和HOLD门槛。
- [Q2] 六条合同分别给OLD、可直接替换英文NEW、中文理由和依据；纠正责任转移、10个工作日、无费无额外信息退订、30天接收、退订名单转移限制；区分自选2日SLA/审批周报与法定要求。
- [Q3] 制作落实三封邮件及供应商条款的launch controls，包括责任人、验收证据及不满足时暂停发送门槛。

## 交付文件

- `/app/output/email_release_pack.docx`：E1/E2/E3用途分类及完整可用英文邮件成稿
- `/app/output/vendor_redline.docx`：六条OLD/NEW/RATIONALE逐项对照及条款定位
- `/app/output/launch_controls.xlsx`：控制项/责任人/验证证据/放行条件

## 硬约束

仅将交付物写入 `/app/output/`，文件名须与要求完全一致；不得修改输入。引用随包材料并保留可复核的来源定位；不得将出题假设写成真实业务事实。

法律替代成稿使用英文，可直接替换原稿；分析、表格与说明允许中文或英文。所有公司、人员、地址、交易与工资事实均为演练假设。

gold.text:
Email release pack

Scope

美国联邦法演练，仅按附件2024 US Code和2025 CFR；非现行法完整法律意见。E1/E3 retain HOLD until valid physical postal address is confirmed and opt-out route tested; no real email sent.

E1

Classification: Commercial — hold pending verified postal address

From: Northstar Tools <sales@example.invalid>

Subject: Advertisement: 20% off new toolboxes

Body:

Advertisement from Northstar Tools. Save 20% on our new toolboxes.

Postal address: [VALID POSTAL ADDRESS—CLIENT TO VERIFY]

Stop all marketing emails: reply UNSUBSCRIBE to optout@example.invalid or use our single-page unsubscribe form. No fee or login required.

Authority: CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(1)–(5); CFR_316_3_2025.pdf §316.3(a)(2) for mixed transactional/commercial purpose; CFR_316_5_2025.pdf §316.5 for opt-out restrictions.

E2

Classification: Transactional/relationship on supplied balance of content

From: Northstar Tools <billing@example.invalid>

Subject: Invoice INV-42 — $240 due February 10, 2025

Body:

Your previously agreed order INV-42 totals $240 and is due February 10, 2025. Contact billing@example.invalid for invoice questions.

See our new toolboxes.

Authority: CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(1)–(5); CFR_316_3_2025.pdf §316.3(a)(2) for mixed transactional/commercial purpose; CFR_316_5_2025.pdf §316.5 for opt-out restrictions.

E3

Classification: Commercial — hold pending verified postal address

From: Northstar Tools <sales@example.invalid>

Subject: Advertisement: New toolboxes; shipping update INV-43

Body:

Advertisement from Northstar Tools. Explore our new toolboxes.

Your order INV-43 has shipped.

Postal address: [VALID POSTAL ADDRESS—CLIENT TO VERIFY]

Stop all marketing emails: reply UNSUBSCRIBE to optout@example.invalid. No fee, login, or extra personal data required.

Authority: CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(1)–(5); CFR_316_3_2025.pdf §316.3(a)(2) for mixed transactional/commercial purpose; CFR_316_5_2025.pdf §316.5 for opt-out restrictions.

gold.description: 六条OLD/NEW/RATIONALE逐项对照及条款定位
gold.text:
Vendor terms — express replacements

Scope

仅按随包历史法源作美国联邦法演练；不构成现行法完整法律意见。NEW可直接替换对应条款，OLD/NEW非Word真实修订模式。

V1

OLD: Vendor owns all compliance; client has no legal responsibility.

NEW: Vendor shall perform the agreed CAN-SPAM controls. Allocation of work does not eliminate either party’s statutory responsibility. Client retains oversight and approval rights.

RATIONALE: 责任不能靠合同转移消灭

Authority: CANSPAM_7702_2024.pdf §7702 definitions of initiate and sender; CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)

V2

OLD: Remove opt-outs within 30 calendar days.

NEW: Honor commercial-email opt-outs within 10 business days of receipt; internal processing target is two business days.

RATIONALE: 10 business days是法定上限；2天是委托内部SLA

Authority: CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(4)(A)(i),(ii)

V3

OLD: Unsubscribe requires login and a $1 processing fee.

NEW: Provide a clear single-page Internet opt-out or reply-email route, without a fee, login, or information beyond the email address.

RATIONALE: 不得收费或额外身份信息/额外步骤

Authority: CFR_316_5_2025.pdf §316.5

V4

OLD: Opt-out links expire after seven days.

NEW: Keep the opt-out mechanism capable of receiving requests for at least 30 days after transmission.

RATIONALE: 接收机制至少30天

Authority: CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(3)(A)(ii)

V5

OLD: Vendor may sell suppressed addresses to fund operations.

NEW: Do not sell or transfer opted-out addresses, except to a provider engaged to comply with the Act; restrict suppression-list use to compliance.

RATIONALE: 退订名单的窄合规例外

Authority: CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(4)(A)(iv)

V6

OLD: No reports or approvals are needed.

NEW: Before launch obtain Client approval of header, subject, advertisement identification, postal address and opt-out. Provide weekly suppression/complaint reports and suspend affected sends until defects are cured.

RATIONALE: 监督和停止发送是本次合同实施条款，不伪称法律明确强制周报

Authority: Negotiated operational safeguard; CANSPAM_7704_2024.pdf §7704(a)(1)–(5) substantive compliance duties, not statutory weekly reporting
